summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp. (formerly ImmunoPrecise Antibodies Ltd.) filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, announcing its inclusion in the FTSE Russell 3000E Index as part of the June 2026 semi-annual reconstitution, effective June 26, 2026. The filing is a routine disclosure of index membership, which may expand institutional investment opportunity but involves no merger, tender, spin-off, or other special-situation transaction. The company remains a foreign private issuer reporting under Rule 13a-16. No financial terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics typically associated with special situations were provided. This is purely a corporate milestone announcement.
